svg.title: Scopegate logical application boundaries
svg.desc: A modular application owns HTTP, use cases and background processes around one primary database. Local adapters are implemented; live provider and host integration remain separate.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
React workspace
Typed HTTP and scoped query cache

div.style: color: rgb(19, 78, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FastAPI HTTP transport
Session or distinct machine principal

div.style: color: rgb(19, 78, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p:

Identity · access · enrollment · catalog · migration
